import { Effect, Schema } from "effect"
import { finiteDelay, fromAgent, setup } from "../../../src/index.js"
/** The brief's agent: one tool `GO`, a turn that never moves the state. */
const someAgent = fromAgent({ budget: 3, deadline: 30_000, tools: { GO: Schema.Struct({ type: Schema.Literal("GO") }) }, turn: (_input: number) => Effect.void })
/** The brief's repro with finiteDelay: a timebox read from the typed context, proven to fire. */
export const machine = setup({
  types: {} as { context: { deadline: number } },
  actors: { child: someAgent },
  delays: { timebox: finiteDelay(({ context }) => context.deadline, { max: 14_400_000 }) },
}).createMachine({
  context: { deadline: 1_000 },
  initial: "running",
  states: {
    running: { invoke: { src: "child", input: 1, onDone: "done" }, on: { GO: "done" }, after: { timebox: "done" } },
    done: { type: "final" },
  },
})
/** provide takes a finiteDelay for the progress delay timebox. */
export const provided = machine.provide({ delays: { timebox: finiteDelay(() => 5, { max: 10 }) } })
